text:
clara: quick thread about adding contextual help and a tiny onboarding tour for regression diffs in prompt-set evals. uploaded flows in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/regress-help/onboarding henry: saw the flows. i like the idea of a single-line contextual help pinned to the diff header ("What's changed"). question: do we show it always or only for first-time users? sam: prefer show-once + a lightweight `?` affordance to re-open. we track that via local storage + backend opt-in for cross-device persistence. anya: a11y notes: the onboarding step must be keyboard reachable, announced by screen readers, and not trap keyboard users. use `role=dialog` for tour steps that block, otherwise `aria-live` for non-blocking hints. clara: thinking of two entry points: 1) a small inline hint next to the heatmap icon, 2) a `Learn` pill in the scorecard header that opens the tour. both should point to the same content. henry: microcopy proposal for inline hint: "What's changed? See top regressions and pinned examples." For the tour step: short bullets + link to docs "How regression is computed". sam: tiny UX debate: where to put `Don't show again` control. Should be inside the tour modal (visible) or nested in settings? i'd vote inside the first step as a checkbox. anya: if offering "Don't show again" prefer accessible checkbox with clear label and `aria-checked` state. avoid ambiguous wording like "hide tips". clara: implementation constraint: the tour should not add heavy JS for every page. lazy-load the tour bundle only when a user triggers it. henry: perf + analytics: instrument events `onboarding.show`, `onboarding.dismiss`, `onboarding.complete`, and `onboarding.dont_show`. capture prompt_set_id and user_role. sam: copy nit: the confetti on "Congrats, you approved" is cute but could be noisy for screen readers. ensure decorative images have empty alt and announce text separately via `aria-live`. anya: code suggestion for non-blocking hint: ``` What's changed? ``` and for modal-first step: ```
...
``` clara: good snippets. also for the pinned hint add `tabindex=0` so it's reachable via keyboard shortcuts (e.g., `g` then `h` to jump to help). henry: design nit: the help pill color on dark theme blends with heatmap. add a subtle border or slightly different token so it reads as actionable. sam: also consider an inline mini-example that expands in-place (toggle) rather than a full modal for quick context. small animation only, respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. anya: accessibility checklist: focus management on open, restore focus on close, visible focus indicator, skip link for long diffs, describe changes with `aria-live`, localize all copy. ops-bot: accessibility-scan: initial pass passed. flagged: tour focus trap not implemented in prototype and dark theme color token missing contrast for help pill. clara: ok i'll update figma with border token + add a smaller in-place expansion for examples. i'll open a PR with lazy load and analytics events, include unit tests for focus restore and `prefers-reduced-motion`. henry: can we add a short e2e that simulates first-time user flow and checks `onboarding.complete` fired? i'll pair on that. sam: i'll mock the local storage / server opt-in in tests. tagging @henry for pairing tomorrow morning. thanks!
